name: AlpCloud Datencenter
notes: Company page describes AlpCloud as a regional IT specialist in Berchtesgadener Land and says its portfolio includes AlpCloud Datencenter, with hosting in its own Rechenzentrum.

name: Datacenter Coburg / SUEC external data center
notes: suec//dacor says customers can use Datacenter Coburg, the external data center of the Coburg utility SUEC; the facility is centrally located in the city of Coburg and offers 24/7 customer access.

name: UnitedColo / NGZ-Server.de Coburg
notes: Directory sources list a Coburg data center at Sonntagsanger 1; DC Hub reports it as operational with 3.0 MW. Older news indicates NGZ historically operated a Coburg data center, so capacity/status should be treated as directory-derived.

name: Autoliv Dachau Rechenzentrum
notes: Glos Doppelbodensysteme reference list records 'Rechenzentrum Autoliv Dachau' as a July 2022 new-build raised-floor project with Rittal as customer; no capacity found.

name: TH Deggendorf Lehr- und Test-Datacenter
developer: Technische Hochschule Deggendorf / Verband Innovative Rechenzentren e.V.
notes: Datacenter-Insider reported a planned teaching and test data center for TH Deggendorf, including four independent edge data center rooms with four racks each; THD's own 2022 press item confirms the related Data-Center Management program and VIRZ cooperation.

name: Bundeswehr Information Technology Center, IT-Bataillon 292
notes: Reports describe a deployable protected ITC / Rechenzentrum being commissioned and tested at Informationstechnikbataillon 292 in Dillingen an der Donau; it consists of 31 protected shipping containers plus support containers and was supplied by Atos.

name: Sonextis Donauwoerth Rechenzentrum
notes: Sonextis says it operates its own certified Rechenzentrum in Donauwoerth, built with Schneider Electric. Local coverage says it opened on 2024-07-06 in Donauwoerth/Riedlingen, cost about EUR15 million, and is the first data center in Landkreis Donau-Ries.

name: Freistaat Bayern Rechenzentrum Markt Schwaben
notes: Public procurement notice by Staatliches Bauamt Muenchen 1 describes a planned highly available data center with office area in Markt Schwaben, NUTS Ebersberg, on 18,364 sq m with about 13,000 sq m usable floor area, VK3 availability, target PUE 1.2 or better, and EUR240 million gross cost cap.
